description_en: Claims an alert. This operation can be used together with escalation policies. When multiple handlers are involved in alert management, each handler can call this operation to claim alerts. After an alert is claimed, the alert enters the Being Processed state
description_zh: 认领告警，配合升级策略使用。 在告警协同处理时可以，认领后表示该告警正在处理中
name: ClaimAlarm

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the alert.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of an alert, see [ListAlertEvents](~~2612346~~).
